title: Additional security under para 4.20 — writ dismissed by reference
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Dilip B. Bhosale, C.J. and Yashwant Varma, J.
disposition: Writ dismissed following batch order in W.P. 30898 of 2016
headnote: Writ challenging demand of additional security under para 4.20 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 dismissed; the Court directed that the order of the same date in Writ-C No. 30898 of 2016 be seen. An earlier Division Bench had connected the petition with similar challenges and restrained demand of additional security until further orders.
facts: M/s Amritvarsha Industries challenged Paschimanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam Ltd.'s demand of additional security under para 4.20 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005. On 2 July 2013 the Court connected the writ with Writ Petition No. 30582 of 2009 and similar matters, allowed three weeks for a counter affidavit, and restrained the respondents from demanding additional security until further orders. On 21 March 2017 a Division Bench dismissed the petition, referring to the order of the same date in Writ-C No. 30898 of 2016.

holding_units.holding: The writ petition challenging demand of additional security under para 4.20 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 was dismissed, with the Court directing that the order of the same date in Writ-C No. 30898 of 2016 be seen.
